class.name: SpatialIndex
class.brief_description: A uniform grid over the XZ plane.
class.description: Every item is filed in each cell its bounding rectangle touches, and a query returns the items of the touched cells. Shared by [TrackServer] and by [TractionServer].

method.name: add
method.description: Files [param item] in every cell [param aabb] (on the XZ plane) touches.

method.name: query
method.description: The items filed in the cells [param aabb] touches, each once - those of the cells, not only the ones whose own rectangle overlaps it.

method.name: remove
method.description: Takes [param item] out of every cell it is filed in.

members.member: The edge length of one grid cell. Set once, before the first item is added - changing it with items filed would leave them in cells of the previous size.
